I'll be there in a few minutes. Just finishing up my morning routine. Good luck with the machine, I hope it's not a hassle.
Sure thing. I'll check it out before we get there. See you soon!
Sounds good. I'll be there in a few minutes. See you soon!
Great, I'll see you at the cafe then. Don't forget to grab a coffee on the way back from your walk!
Thanks, Dolores. I'll see you at the cafe.
You too, Maeve. It'll be great to see you there. I'll be at Hobbs in a bit.
You too, Dolores. See you soon!
Perfect, Maeve. Just don't forget your apron and name tag. See you in a bit!
You too, Dolores. See you in a bit!
